subject.title: [Bug]: Native Talk button triggers OpenAI Realtime WebRTC call and fails with 500 when Realtime is not configured

question: Should Control UI browser Talk start from implicit OpenAI realtime credential availability, or only after an explicit talk.realtime readiness/preflight says the provider is usable?
rationale: Current code and docs intentionally allow API-key, OAuth-profile, and external Codex auth to satisfy OpenAI Realtime, while this report expects a local/non-realtime Talk setup not to start OpenAI Realtime at all.

options.title: Gate On Gateway Readiness
options.body: Disable or block browser Talk before microphone startup unless talk.catalog or a preflight reports a usable realtime provider, while preserving the chosen credential policy.

options.title: Keep Implicit Credential Activation
options.body: Treat configured OpenAI/Codex realtime auth as sufficient and narrow the issue to clearer diagnostics for provider or API failures.

options.title: Require Explicit Realtime Config
options.body: Only show or start browser Talk when talk.realtime is explicitly configured, accepting the upgrade impact for users who currently rely on automatic OpenAI auth discovery.

recommendation.title: Gate On Gateway Readiness
recommendation.body: Disable or block browser Talk before microphone startup unless talk.catalog or a preflight reports a usable realtime provider, while preserving the chosen credential policy.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete owns the most recent merged OpenAI Realtime auth policy and docs change that defines the current enablement behavior.
